description: My Life: Coming from Where I'm From” Born and raised in Midtown, South St. Petersburg — the most impoverished area in all of Pinellas County. That’s where my story begins. A place where opportunity felt out of reach, and struggle was the norm. But it’s also where I learned the value of community, the strength of perseverance, and the power of having someone believe in you.
